question.text: Two charges $+q$ and $-q$ are placed at points $A$ and $B$ respectively which are at a distance $2 L$ apart. $C$ is the mid point of $A$ and $B$. The workdone in moving a charge $+Q$ along the semicircle $\operatorname{CSD}\left(W_1\right)$ and along the line $\operatorname{CBD}\left(W_2\right)$ are

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \text {  } W_{C S D}=Q\left(V_{D A}-V_{C A}\right)=\frac{Q q}{4 \pi \epsilon_0 L}\left[\frac{1}{3}-1\right]=\frac{-2 Q q}{12 \pi \epsilon_0 L}=\frac{-Q q}{6 \pi \epsilon_0 L}=W_{C B D} \\ & W_{C B D}=W_{C S D} \text { path independent }\end{aligned}$
